No dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl|bash`, `base64` decoding) are present, and the source URLs point directly to the project's own GitHub repositories and releases. There is no runtime or build-time code injection, no use of mutable refs (like `git pull`), and no post-install scripts or hooks that could introduce side effects.
